items.title: Edward "Noon" Johnson Interview, 1960-05-28
items.q: we went to Nashville, Tennessee, with a fellow called Steve Devoidy

ctx.x: Did you travel anyplace else after that, besides the Biloxi Hotel?

Oh yeah, we went to Nashville, Tennessee, with a fellow called Steve Devoidy. He was a sailman for the Tennessee and Animal Company. And we played at the Belle Mique Club over there. What player did you play?
